I ran a Monte Carlo simulation calibrated to the actual 
adjustment factor distributions in the corpus:

→ Deadweight median: 20%
→ Attribution: 25.5%  
→ Drop-off: 21.5%

Applied to non-compliant reports:

Observed median ratio: 3.56:1
Corrected median ratio: 1.92:1

That is an 85% overstatement at the median.

Formal assurance helps — assured reports score 10.4 percentage 
points higher. But even assured reports reach only 22.9% of 
the maximum standard.
